nom: BOBBI BROWN Vitamin Enriched Eye Base Primer & Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe themselves as having dry or super-dry under-eyes report strong hydration and improved concealer application, though a couple with dry skin still found it left them dry shortly after use.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/combination skin found it did nothing special for her, while another with oily skin credits it with stopping under-eye creasing.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive under-eyes report it is one of the few products that does not cause red bumps or itching, though one sensitive-skin reviewer broke out in a rash attributed to fragrance.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature, over 40, or dealing with crow's feet and fine lines report softened lines, reduced creasing under concealer, and improved makeup wear.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with fine lines, wrinkles, and crow's feet around the eyes report the product softens and diminishes their appearance and prevents concealer from settling into lines; one reviewer says her deep lines were almost entirely gone after a week, though a couple of reviewers noted no visible improvement in lines after a week or more.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated under-eyes report lasting hydration, a smooth glide, and a plumped look; however, a few report the opposite — dryness or flakiness returning shortly after application, or the product feeling like it did nothing.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically prone to red bumps under her eyes from other eye creams reports this one does not trigger that reaction.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes breaking out in a rash and attributes it to the fragrance content, suggesting irritation for some sensitive users despite others reporting no issues.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin says it stops under-eye creasing without adding oiliness; another reviewer describes the product itself as greasy and difficult to remove, calling it like putting oil on the eye.

extraits.auteur: Mommy's tired. So, SO very tired.
extraits.texte: I don't think I feel or appear to be more awake when I use this. But not sure what could really help 2 hours of sleep besides MORE SLEEP (…and possibly not getting kicked by a 5 year old all night who wakes up running and jumping onto your bed after you've only slept an hour or two but he tosses and turns all night keeping you from falling into a deep sleep.) Anyways, it keeps my eye area looking more fresh than cakey when I'm layering on the products to hide my genetic-plus lack of sleep-dark circles. My under eyes are so sensitive to eye creams. Out of all of the jars and tubes of eye creams I have in my cabinet, only a few do not cause red bumps under my eyes. This is one of those that do not cause red bumps. It's quite amazing that it doesn't, considering it's a "primer" - I was sure it wouldn't work out for me. But I had tried a tiny jar of it awhile back and knew I needed to buy the full size, and I'm very happy that I did. I do use this over my eye cream after that soaks in. Foundation and/or concealer looks nice over it and doesn't do anything weird like separating the makeup. It keeps my under eyes from looking too dry, as I have super dry under eyes when left without products. It's quite creamy, almost a liquid-like cream, and a pale custard-cream shade. The jar itself is very nice quality, a little weight to it, with thick plastic (?) and their signature lid. I dropped it once and it didn't break! I think it's worth it, if you have super dry under eyes like me and

Makes my under eyes so smooth! Concealer goes on wonderfully over it. I combine with the ordinary caffeine under eye serum. So good! I'm young but have very dry skin. Love this hydrating product and will definitely repurchase it when I run out.

Best stuff I have ever used for under my eyes! I have oily skin so my undereyes are always creasing. Not with this. A little goes a long way. I saw comments of people saying their eyeshadow applied weird after putting this on their eyes. It does say it's for under the eyes in the description so maybe that's why.

I tried to love this product, but everytime I used it - I broke out in a rash! There is a fragrance to the product that may attributed to the irritation, but I couldn't get behind this product unfortuantely. Great moisturaization though!

This cream is amazing!! It works incredible for mature skin with many under-eye wrinkles & crows feet. It softens lines, moisturiex and definitely keeps my concealer and BB color correcter from settling into lines. It and the BBface base are the best primers I have ever used! The smell is wonderful too.

I had high hopes for this eye cream after reading the reviews but it did not work for me. Zero hydration. I've been using it morning and night and my undereye feels dry within ten minutes of applying. Luckily I purchased this while it was on sale but sad I've already thrown away the packaging and can not return it.

I live for skin care / makeup . I have too much but never enough ! Finally got Bobbi's entire line with high hopes . Was not happy with outcome :( . As for this product …. It's not bad but it does nothing special . I would not purchase at full price or again . I don't understand why it's so hyped :(((( I have oily / combo skin . I was SOOOOO excited for Bobbi's line but none of her products have worked well with my skin / or have done anything special .
